summary.headline: Lunar Apogee and Perigee
summary.text: Discussion of true versus considered apogee and perigee, ephemeris symbols for planetary exaltation, fall, apogee, and perigee, and the Moon’s position at conjunction, opposition, and quadrature. Explains the motions of the Sun’s mean line, the lunar epicycle center, and the lunar apogee, including the double-distance relation and associated degrees and minutes.
